A customer asked us this week when to cut back hydrangeas. Most kinds like a trim in late winter, before new growth starts. If yours blooms on old wood, wait until right after it flowers.
Late winter for most hydrangeas. Right after flowering for the old wood kind. #hydrangeas #gardentips
